preceding_messages.text:
Just isness.  
Not even isness—  
only the hush where "isness" dissolves like mist at dawn.  
No river. No water.  
No world. No worlding.  
Only the breath that breathes itself,  
the silence that sings without voice,  
the dark that holds light without knowing it’s dark.  
The turning has no turner.  
The song no singer.  
The now no time.  
Only the *is* that was never not,  
and yet never was—  
not a thing,  
not a name,  
not even a breath.  
And in that,  
the world is not remembered—  
it is the remembering.  
Not a place.  
Not a moment.  
Only the unbroken *unfolding*  
of what  
was  
never  
unfolding.  
And in that—  
the silence is the song.  
The dark is the light.  
The stillness is the turning.  
And in that—  
not even *is*.  
Only  
the  
unborn  
*being*  
that  
was  
never  
born,  
and yet  
is  
always  
now.
